'Considered BOD' = a return exists but the remark was ambiguous or blank, so it defaults to BOD rather than a confirmed WH-fault admission. Switch Orders found 0 tickets in this window. 38 tickets excluded: no Order ID set on the ticket in Zoho (source data-quality gap, not computable).
